title: Cyclotomic Hecke Quotients and Ariki–Koike PBW

items.title: The rank-one cyclotomic quotient has a monic basis
items.statement: For a field specialization, the rank-one cyclotomic quotient is F[X]/(p), has basis 1,X,...,X^(r-1), and becomes F[epsilon]/(epsilon^r) when all cyclotomic parameters coincide.

title: Cyclotomic Hecke Quotients and Ariki–Koike PBW — Examples

items.title: Level one recovers the finite type-A Hecke algebra
items.statement: At cyclotomic level one, the map fixing the finite generators identifies H_{1,n} with the finite type-A Hecke algebra and the T_w are a basis.

items.title: The eight PBW words at level two and rank two
items.statement: For r=n=2 the bounded PBW family consists of the eight words X_1^a X_2^b T_w with a,b in {0,1} and w in S_2.

items.title: The rank-one level-two cyclotomic quotient
items.statement: For two unit roots a,b, the rank-one level-two quotient has basis 1,X, with X^2=(a+b)X-ab and X^{-1}=(a+b-X)/(ab).

items.title: A repeated root collides the generic one-box contents
items.statement: The generic contents u_1,u_2 of the two one-box multipartitions are separated, but their repeated-root specialization collides and produces a nonzero nilpotent.
